def factor_volume_beta_ewm(df):
    """Exponentially weighted beta of returns on volume changes, emphasizing recent volume-price confirmation."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    log_volume = np.log(df_copy['volume'].clip(lower=1e-12))
    dlog_volume = log_volume.diff()
    cov = ret.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).cov(dlog_volume)
    var_vol = dlog_volume.ewm(span=20, min_periods=20).var()
    beta = cov / var_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    df_copy['factor_volume_beta_ewm'] = beta
    return df_copy['factor_volume_beta_ewm']
